rationale: No Playwright spec exercises the nav-group flyout or the dismiss-open-dropdown behaviour. openNavFlyoutChild in commonActions.js hovers a group tile only to click a child (navigation helper), and no spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ uses nav-group-flyout-* selectors or asserts a dropdown was dismissed. The change (ONavGroup.open() now dispatches Escape to close open reka dropdowns) has no E2E coverage, so a brand-new GeneralTests spec is required. It must be registered in ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json under the GeneralTests shard.
